sop_modules.name: Setup — Protection, Fixture Masking, Vehicle/Driveway, Equipment
sop_modules.description: Full setup module for exterior engineered wood siding repaint. Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based), hardscape walk/patio, fixture/HVAC masking, vehicle/driveway overspray protection (RP-specific, spray_backroll only), extended landscape overspray, equipment setup.

tasks.name: Landscape Perimeter Protection Setup
tasks.description: Deploy tarps along house perimeter where landscape is adjacent. RP scope includes scraping debris and wash water runoff containment. LF-based.

tasks.name: Hardscape Protection Setup
tasks.description: Deploy drop cloths and plastic over walkways, patios adjacent to siding.

tasks.name: Fixture and Utility Masking
tasks.description: Mask exterior light fixtures, utility panels, hose bibs. Bag HVAC units if adjacent. RP: all fixtures installed and operational.

tasks.name: Extended Landscape Overspray Protection (Spray Only)
tasks.description: Extended overspray protection beyond perimeter edge tarps. spray_backroll only.

tasks.name: Vehicle/Driveway Overspray Protection
tasks.description: Deploy poly sheeting over vehicles, driveway adjacent to siding. RP-specific — occupied home context.

tasks.name: Spray/Backroll Equipment Setup
tasks.description: Configure airless sprayer + stage 18-inch backroll frame, roller covers. 2-person operation. Per session.
tasks.transfer_source: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_SPRAY — adds backroll staging

tasks.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup
tasks.description: Stage brushes, rollers, trays, extension poles. Fallback method.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Landscape/hardscape first -> Fixture/HVAC masking -> Vehicle/driveway (spray only) -> Equipment setup last.

sop_modules.name: Condition Assessment — Visual, Adhesion, Chalk, Moisture, Edge Seal, Caulk
sop_modules.description: RP-specific multi-point assessment module. Results drive substrate state assignment, primer selection, prep intensity, condition scale. EW-specific: edge seal integrity check (unique to engineered wood RP). FIXED time per elevation.

tasks.name: Visual Condition Inspection Per Elevation
tasks.description: Scan all siding surfaces per elevation. Map cracking, peeling, chalking, fading, edge swelling. Assign substrate state. Photograph defects.

quality_notes.QT3: Standard visual with work light per elevation.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan with raking light, photograph all defect areas.

tasks.name: Adhesion Test (ASTM D3359)
tasks.description: Cross-hatch tape test at representative sections per elevation. Minimum 2 locations per elevation.

tasks.name: Chalk Test (White Cloth Rub)
tasks.description: Rub white cloth across painted surfaces. Moderate/heavy chalk = chalk-binding primer required. Test each elevation.

tasks.name: Moisture Probe at Joints and Edges
tasks.description: Pin-type moisture meter at siding-to-trim junctions, butt joints, cut edges, and water damage areas. MC >15% = STOP WORK for coating. EW is more moisture-sensitive than FC.

tasks.name: Edge Seal Integrity Check
tasks.description: Inspect all visible cut edges at butt joints, miters, and field cuts for signs of failed edge seal — swelling, springback, soft spots. EW-specific assessment. Probe with utility knife at suspect areas. Failed edges require repair in prep module.
tasks.transfer_source: RP_NEW (replaces NC TSK_ENSD_SEAL_CUT_EDGES — assessment, not application)

tasks.name: Caulk Assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop' Protocol
tasks.description: Assess all joint types per elevation: siding-to-trim (corner, window, door, frieze), butt joints, foundation transitions. Rate condition: intact/cracked/failed. Determine replacement scope. Butt joints assessed but NOT re-caulked per NC prohibition.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Assessment completes before ANY prep work. Visual first -> adhesion -> chalk -> moisture -> edge seal -> caulk. All per elevation.

sop_modules.name: Surface Preparation — Wash, Scrape, Degloss, Mildew, Caulk, Moisture, Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Condition-driven prep module. Low-pressure power wash (500-1000 PSI OK for EW), scrape/feather, degloss/scuff, chalk remediation, mildew treatment, caulk remove+replace, moisture check, dust cleanup.

tasks.name: Low-Pressure Power Wash (500-1000 PSI)
tasks.description: Power wash all siding surfaces at 500-1000 PSI with 25-40 degree fan tip. Removes dirt, chalk, loose paint, mildew. CRITICAL: never exceed 1000 PSI — damages OSB core at joints/cut edges. 24 hr minimum dry time before coating. TSP at QT4.
tasks.notes: KEY DEPARTURE: EW allows power wash at 500-1000 PSI. FC RP prohibits all power washing. NC EW uses garden hose only.
tasks.transfer_source: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_WASH_LOW_PRESSURE — upgraded to power wash for RP

tasks.name: Mildew/Algae Biocide Treatment
tasks.description: Apply biocide solution to mildew/algae areas. 10-15 min dwell. Rinse with low-pressure water. Common on north-facing/shaded elevations.

tasks.name: Scrape Failing/Peeling Paint + Feather Sand Edges
tasks.description: Carbide scraper to remove failing/peeling paint to sound substrate. 80-100 grit feather-edge sanding mandatory on ALL scraped transitions. Condition-driven: light for FAIR (SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT), heavy for POOR (SS_EXT_PEELING).

tasks.name: Degloss/Scuff Existing Sound Paint
tasks.description: 150-180 grit scuff sand for adhesion profile on sound existing paint. Chemical deglosser alternative. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT primarily.
tasks.transfer_source: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_SCUFF_SAND — different context (existing paint vs factory primer)

tasks.name: Chalk Remediation Pre-Treatment
tasks.description: Chemical chalk remover on stubborn areas after power wash. For SS_EXT_CHALKING where power wash did not fully remove chalk residue. Applied before chalk-binding primer.

tasks.name: Remove Failed Caulk at Joints
tasks.description: Remove cracked/failed caulk at siding-to-trim junctions and any previously caulked butt joints. Butt joint caulk REMOVED but NOT re-caulked (moisture trap prohibition from NC). Clean joint surfaces for re-application.

tasks.name: Apply New Caulk at Siding-to-Trim Joints
tasks.description: Apply exterior paintable caulk at siding-to-trim joints (corner boards, window/door casings, frieze). Tool smooth. Do NOT re-caulk butt joints.
tasks.transfer_source: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_CAULK_JOINTS — split into remove+apply for RP

tasks.name: Moisture Content Verification
tasks.description: Pin-type moisture meter checks at cut edges, joints, and areas flagged during assessment. Must read <15% MC before coating. EW is more moisture-sensitive than FC — mandatory at ALL tiers.
tasks.transfer_source: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_MOISTURE_CHECK — RP context: check after wash dry time

tasks.name: Prep Dust and Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Compressed air or tack cloth dust removal after sanding/scraping. Collect scraping debris. Surface ready for primer.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Power wash -> 24hr dry -> Mildew treat (if needed) -> Scrape/feather OR Degloss/scuff -> Chalk remediation (if needed) -> Caulk remove -> Caulk apply -> Moisture check -> Dust cleanup.

sop_modules.name: Prime — State-Driven Primer Application
sop_modules.description: State-driven primer: chalk-binding (SS_EXT_CHALKING full surface), acrylic stain-block (SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_PEELING spot or full), bonding (exposed ExpertFinish). Module skipped for SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT with verified adhesion. NO alkali-resistant primer — EW is neutral pH.

tasks.name: Prime Coat — Spray + Back-Roll Application
tasks.description: Combined spray + immediate back-roll prime coat. Two-person operation: sprayer leads, roller follows within wet edge. Primary RP prime method for all profiles.
tasks.transfer_source: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL — RP primary method, slightly different rate

tasks.name: Prime Coat — Brush/Roll Application
tasks.description: Brush for edges, roller for field. Fallback method for <750 SF, occupied-adjacent, or high wind.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coats — Coat 1 and Coat 2
sop_modules.description: Finish coat application. QT2: 1 coat. QT3/QT4: 2 coats per LP warranty. spray_backroll primary, brush_roll fallback.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray + Back-Roll Application
tasks.description: Combined spray + back-roll finish coat 1. Two-person operation.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Application
tasks.description: Brush for edges, roller for field. Fallback method.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray + Back-Roll Application
tasks.description: Combined spray + back-roll finish coat 2. Final appearance coat.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Application
tasks.description: Brush/roll finish coat 2. Final appearance coat.

sop_modules.name: Interstage Inspection, Sand, Touch-Up
sop_modules.description: Between finish coats. Inspection at QT3+. Intercoat sand at QT4 only. Module skipped for QT2 single-coat.

tasks.name: Interstage Inspection
tasks.description: Visual inspection of first finish coat. QT3 quick scan, QT4 systematic with marking.

quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection at 6 ft viewing distance. Mark all visible defects.

tasks.name: Interstage Light Sand
tasks.description: 220 grit light scuff between finish coats. QT4 only.

tasks.name: Interstage Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during interstage inspection.

quality_notes.QT4: Fix all found defects. Blend repairs.

tasks.name: Intercoat Dust Removal
tasks.description: Tack cloth or compressed air after interstage sanding. QT4 only.

sop_modules.name: Final Inspection, Touch-Up, Protection Teardown, Equipment Cleanup, Site Cleanup, Customer Walkthrough
sop_modules.description: Final module: walkthrough inspection, touch-up, protection removal, equipment cleaning, site debris cleanup, customer walkthrough (RP-specific).

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
tasks.description: Ground-level walkthrough of all elevations. Check coverage uniformity.

quality_notes.QT4: Ground-level with binoculars for upper elevations. 6 ft standard.

tasks.name: Final Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during final inspection.

tasks.name: Protection Material Removal
tasks.description: Remove all tarps, plastic, tape, fixture bags, HVAC covers along perimeter.

tasks.name: Clean Equipment
tasks.description: Flush airless sprayer, clean tips/filters, coil hoses. Clean roller frames and dispose saturated roller covers. RP slightly longer than NC due to backroll equipment.
tasks.transfer_source: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_CLEAN_EQUIPMENT — adds backroll cleanup

tasks.name: Site Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Collect all debris (paint chips, sandpaper, caulk tubes, tape, roller covers, sealer containers). RP adds scraping debris collection. Dispose. Final site walkthrough.
tasks.transfer_source: MODIFIED from TSK_ENSD_SITE_CLEANUP — adds scraping debris

tasks.name: Customer Walkthrough
tasks.description: Walk each elevation with homeowner. Verify color/sheen satisfaction. Point out any areas of concern. Document completion. RP-specific — occupied home.

sop_modules.name: EPA Lead-Safe RRP Containment (Shared Exterior Module)
sop_modules.description: Shared exterior RRP module. Conditional on pre_1978 = true AND lead-positive. Lead screening, containment setup, wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, containment teardown. Do NOT duplicate when running alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP or other exterior RP specs.

tasks.name: Lead Paint Screening (XRF or Swab Test)
tasks.description: Test representative sections for lead content. XRF gun preferred. EPA-certified swab test alternative.

tasks.name: RRP Containment Setup
tasks.description: Deploy 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure. Secure with stakes/weights. Mark perimeter with barrier tape. Per-elevation setup.

tasks.name: RRP Wet Scraping Method
tasks.description: Wet mist before scraping to minimize dust. HEPA vacuum collection at scrape point. EPA-compliant method.

tasks.name: HEPA Vacuum Cleanup
tasks.description: HEPA vacuum all containment areas, windowsills, ledges, and work zone. Mandatory before containment teardown.

tasks.name: RRP Containment Teardown and Disposal
tasks.description: Fold contaminated poly inward (paint side in). Bag for certified disposal. Document chain of custody.
